newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes higher amid increased mill demand.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes higher amid increased mill demand.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed mostly higher, boosted by hedge lifting amid signs of a slight increase in mill demand, traders said.
Dealers also noted sentiment was boosted by strong prices for high grade rice overseas.
Rice futures ended five cents per cwt higher to unchanged with July up five at $11.66.
Futures volume was estimated by CBOT at 200 lots, up from 191 on Friday. Options volume was pegged at 75 lots.
